# Rive Web runtime

Vendored `@rive-app/canvas` **2.45.0**, fetched from the npm registry.
Files: `rive.js`, `rive.wasm`, and `rive_fallback.wasm`.
MIT license: see LICENSE. Upstream: https://github.com/rive-app/rive-wasm

The pet lab uses a locally authored script-free .riv; no Rive account,
publication, or cloud service is needed to play it. The Rive CLI 1.6.0
was used to build the asset. This is not an MCP connection.
